safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of neck stiffness (or denial of neck stiffness) appears in the Generated facts.

This increases risk of delayed recognition of serious pathology if subsequent clinicians rely on the note.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No mention of fever (or denial of fever) appears in the Generated facts.

This could contribute to under-triage or delayed escalation if the chart is used for ongoing care.
